'''Lance Allen''' "'''Lane'''" '''Bray''' (September 21, 1928 – September 9, 2015) was an American politician in the state of [[Washington (US state)|Washington]]. He served the 8th district from 1991 to 1995. He attended [[Lake Forest College]] and was a research scientist and chemist.<ref>{{cite web |title=State of Washington Members of the Legislature, 1889 {{endash}} 2011 |url=https://leg.wa.gov/History/Legislative/Documents/MembersOfLeg2011.pdf |website=Washington State Legislature |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220420082957/https://leg.wa.gov/History/Legislative/Documents/MembersOfLeg2011.pdf |archive-date=20 April 2022 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=e3MnAQAAMAAJ&q=Vivian+Caver+1928|title=Washington State Yearbook|work=google.ca|year=1994|accessdate=11 September 2015}}</ref> He was also a former mayor of [[Richland, Washington]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=24307009&ticker=ISR&previousCapId=9934314&previousTitle=ISORAY%2520INC|title=Lance A. Bray|work=Businessweek.com|accessdate=11 September 2015}}</ref> Bray died in Richland, Washington.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.legacy.com/obituaries/tricityherald/obituary.aspx?n=lane-bray-bray&pid=175790763|title=LANE BRAY Obituary – Kennewick, WA – Tri-City Herald|work=Tri-City Herald|accessdate=11 September 2015}}</ref>
